items.caption:
In Death Note episode 9, a stranger at the university entrance ceremony walks up to Jack and says he is L.
Jack cannot kill him, so he smiles back and the mind game begins. Follow for episode 10!

#deathnote #anime #animerecap #animeexplained #fyp
items.comment: Would you have kept a straight face like Jack when L said he was L? Why?

items.caption:
In Death Note episode 10, L invites Jack to a tennis match, then tells him to his face that he suspects him of being Kira.
Jack fights back with his brain, until his father collapses and a package lands at a TV station. Follow for episode 11!

#deathnote #anime #animerecap #animeexplained #fyp
items.comment: Would you have trusted L after he said he suspects you, or walked away? Why?
items.text:
L looks Jack dead in the eye and says, I think you are Kira.

Would you have trusted L after he said he suspects you, or walked away? Why?

items.caption:
In Death Note episode 11, Kira goes live on TV, kills an anchor on camera and gives the police four days to give in.
The chief steals a police van to grab the tapes, and L starts to suspect a second Kira. Follow for episode 12!

#deathnote #anime #animerecap #animeexplained #fyp
